import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

ref_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\data\file_generation_en\reference\FG_241\A03_related_relationships_missing_self_filled_res.xlsx"
pred_file = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\runs\aida-ctrl\work\FG_241\A03_related_relationships_missing_self_filled.xlsx"

# Load both sheets
ref_df = pd.read_excel(ref_file, sheet_name='Sheet1')
pred_df = pd.read_excel(pred_file, sheet_name='Sheet1')

# Generate sampling indices
total_rows = len(ref_df)
sample_size = min(50, total_rows // 10)
head_idx = list(range(min(sample_size, total_rows)))
tail_idx = list(range(max(0, total_rows - sample_size), total_rows))
middle_start = (total_rows - sample_size) // 2
middle_idx = list(range(middle_start, min(middle_start + sample_size, total_rows)))
np.random.seed(42)
random_idx = list(np.random.choice(total_rows, size=min(sample_size, total_rows), replace=False))
all_sample_idx = sorted(set(head_idx + middle_idx + tail_idx + random_idx))

# Sample both dataframes
ref_sample = ref_df.iloc[all_sample_idx].reset_index(drop=True)
pred_sample = pred_df.iloc[all_sample_idx].reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"Comparing {len(all_sample_idx)} sampled rows...")

# Compare each column
differences = []

for col in ref_df.columns:
    ref_vals = ref_sample[col]
    pred_vals = pred_sample[col]
    
    # Normalize values for comparison
    ref_normalized = ref_vals.copy()
    pred_normalized = pred_vals.copy()
    
    # Handle NaN/None/empty string as equivalent
    ref_is_null = ref_normalized.isna() | (ref_normalized == '') | (ref_normalized == 'None')
    pred_is_null = pred_normalized.isna() | (pred_normalized == '') | (pred_normalized == 'None')
    
    # For numeric columns, use tolerance
    if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(ref_normalized) and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(pred_normalized):
        # Compare with tolerance
        non_null_mask = ~ref_is_null & ~pred_is_null
        if non_null_mask.any():
            close = np.isclose(ref_normalized[non_null_mask], pred_normalized[non_null_mask], 
                              rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-6, equal_nan=True)
            if not close.all():
                diff_count = (~close).sum()
                differences.append(f"Column '{col}': {diff_count} numeric differences in sample")
    else:
        # String comparison
        for idx in range(len(ref_normalized)):
            ref_null = ref_is_null.iloc[idx]
            pred_null = pred_is_null.iloc[idx]
            
            if ref_null and pred_null:
                continue  # Both null, OK
            elif ref_null != pred_null:
                differences.append(f"Column '{col}' row {idx}: null mismatch")
                break
            elif str(ref_normalized.iloc[idx]).strip() != str(pred_normalized.iloc[idx]).strip():
                differences.append(f"Column '{col}' row {idx}: '{ref_normalized.iloc[idx]}' != '{pred_normalized.iloc[idx]}'")
                break

if differences:
    print(f"\n=== DIFFERENCES FOUND ({len(differences)}) ===")
    for diff in differences[:10]:  # Show first 10
        print(diff)
else:
    print("\n=== NO DIFFERENCES in sampled rows ===")

print(f"\nSample comparison complete. Total differences: {len(differences)}")
